description: The load-balancer spec documents no 404 on DeleteLoadBalancer or DeleteCredentials, but the API returns 404 for a load balancer or credential that does not exist: STACKIT's own Terraform provider (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/loadbalancer/loadbalancer/resource.go and stackit/internal/services/loadbalancer/observability-credential/resource.go, read 2026-11-01) treats http.StatusNotFound as already deleted in both Delete handlers. Type it as the model's NotFound so callers can tell a missing object from other failures.
